description: Moscovium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Mc and atomic number 115. It was first synthesized in 2003 by a joint team of Russian and American scientists at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia. It is a p-block transactinide element in the 7th period and group 15, making it the heaviest pnictogen.
characteristics: Moscovium is an extremely radioactive element with its most stable known isotope, moscovium-290, having a half-life of only 0.65 seconds. It is calculated to have properties similar to lighter pnictogens and to be a post-transition metal, with significant similarities to thallium. Chemical experimentation has confirmed that moscovium is less reactive than its lighter homologue bismuth.
